name: Hedonist
description: You have lived a life devoted to the unrestrained pursuit of pleasure, chasing every sensation and experience without shame.

traits: Life's a party and I'm the guest of honor.
I never met a stranger—only lovers I haven't bedded yet.
I collect stories the way others collect scars.
If it's worth doing, it's worth doing loudly.
Tomorrow's for regrets; tonight is for pleasure.
I live for the moment someone's eyes light up when they see me.
Rules are for people who don't know how to have fun.
My reputation arrives ten minutes before I do.

ideals.text: Freedom. No chains, no shame, no regrets.
Joy. The world is better when everyone's smiling and satisfied.
Legend. I want my name whispered in every tavern from here to the horizon.
Connection. Every body is a new story, every heart a new friend.
Selfishness. I'm here for a good time; not for you, just for me.

bonds: There's one tavern that will always have my back—and my tab running.
A former lover swore they'd kill me if they ever saw me again… worth the risk.
My crew of drinking and bedding buddies would follow me into any party.
I'm searching for the partner who finally made me feel something deeper.
I owe a dangerous crime lord for one too many "free" nights.
My family thinks I'm dead; I like it that way.
flaws: I can't say no to a pretty face or a dare.
I forget names five minutes after the clothes come off.
I'll risk everything for one more thrill.
My mouth starts parties my body can't always finish.
I leave a trail of broken hearts and jealous lovers wherever I go.
Hangovers? What hangovers? I just keep going.
